title: Broken
body: Env vars don’t work. Tab is just not available. No docs or website to speak of. Just gotta flounder around. Miserable. I would prefer to pay this dev, but I’m having a better experience on free terminus. $10 wasted.

title: Can’t scroll & cursor gets displaced
body: I’m using Termix to connect to a tmux server on my laptop running Claude Code and I can’t scroll up to see output and the cursor keeps getting by displaced and moving onto the next line and when I delete chars the phantom line above remains the same. This sucks! I really want to use this app but it’s practically useless for me at this point for the purpose it’s supposed to provide.

title: Save your money and just use a free one
body: I use this to ssh into a server and randomly the entire terminal history will start re-cycling through the screen in an endless stream. Super annoying and the only way I’ve found to get it to stop is to ctrl+c or ctrl+d. There’s nothing I’ve found premium about this to justify paying even .99 as many of the free versions have better functionality. For example, the directional keys on the free apps have a swipe feature, this one is crude buttons. Something I do like about this one is the theme feature. It’s crude and has decent defaults. Overall save your money, unless dev adds new features and gets to the bottom of that infinite scroll issue it really isn’t worth it.

title: NOT AN SFTP CLIENT
body: While this does SSH very well, and even SCP, you can’t even add an SFTP host, it’s seemingly all SSH based. The title is very misleading, which is a shame, since I was tricked into getting the pro version thinking it offered SFTP. If all you need is SSH/SCP, this is a valid tool, but it’s a far cry from an FTP client.

title: Looks great but…
body: It's one of the better iOS terminal emulators, but it doesn't work with my shell: fish Every other iOS terminal emulators has no problem with fish. Any plans to fix that?

title: It is a SSH and SFTP client ;)
body: And a good one at that! The other review is confused in that SFTP != FTPS. SFTP is built on top of SSH — which this app supports. FTPS on the other hand is built on top of FTP adding TLS/SSL encryption — which is different and not supported. If you need an SSH/SFTP client that syncs across iOS/iPadOS/MacOS with good features at a good price, this is it.

title: Worth every penny.
body: This SSH client is probably the best one for the money. Really enjoying how much it feels like a native iOS app. I didn’t even need any features beyond the free version but it’s so much better than the competition that I decided to pay for it as a thank you!
